title: Danh Vo in Conversation with Tom McDonough
body:
Join artist Danh Vo in conversation with art historian and critic Tom McDonough as they discuss Vo’s exhibition Ships that pass in the night, in Baille Court at the Art Gallery of Ontario.

See the Art Gallery of Ontario website for further information

Danh Vo: Ships that pass in the night is organized by The Shen Foundation in collaboration with the Art Gallery of Ontario. This presentation is curated by Adam Welch, Carol and Morton Rapp Curator of Modern and Contemporary Art, in collaboration with Kitty Scott, Director and Curator, The Shen Foundation.
